# Matías Blanc — Full-Stack & Web Engineer

> Technical portfolio and Spanish blog by Matías Blanc, a Computer Engineering student and developer based in Coquimbo, Chile.

## Expertise
- **Frontend and web:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Astro, Tailwind CSS, HTML and CSS
- **Backend and data:** Python, FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, WebSockets and REST APIs
- **Mobile:** React Native and Expo
- **Tools and infrastructure:** Linux, Docker, Git, GitHub, Neovim and Vercel

## Projects
- [FECHITAT](https://matiasblanc.dev/projects/fechitat): An Astro and Sanity institutional website prototype for the Chilean Federation of Traditional Taekwon-Do. It focuses on information architecture, school discovery, events, documents and accessible public content. The portfolio case study does not currently claim a working public domain.
- [ITF App](https://matiasblanc.dev/projects/itf-app): A functional React Native and Expo prototype for practitioner identity, dojang management, attendance, progression and competition-day information. It is not an official ITF platform and uses temporary or simulated data for some tournament flows.
- [Made in Chile](https://matiasblanc.dev/projects/madeinchile): An Astro, React and Supabase directory for discovering software and technology projects created in Chile. The catalogue prioritizes project context, freshness and useful outbound visits over volume.
  - Live site: https://madeinchile.tech
- [Riego Mendoza](https://matiasblanc.dev/projects/riegomendoza): A mobile-first React and Vite website that explains irrigation services and guides visitors toward a useful WhatsApp conversation.
  - Live site: https://riego-mendoza.vercel.app
  - Source: https://github.com/MatiasBlanc/riego-mendoza

## Blog
- [¿Cómo aplicar Clean Architecture en React sin sobreingeniería?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/clean-architecture-reactjs): A practical guide to domain rules, use cases, infrastructure adapters, UI boundaries and criteria for extracting layers.
- [¿Cómo aprender a programar sin depender de tutoriales?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/como-aprender-a-programar-sin-coleccionar-tutoriales): A practice-first route based on choosing a direction, building small projects, reading errors and using AI as a tutor.
- [¿Qué debe demostrar un proyecto de portafolio de programación?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/que-hace-valioso-un-proyecto-de-portafolio): A framework for presenting context, users, decisions, contribution, evidence, limitations and project status.
- [¿Cómo organizar tus dotfiles para reconstruir tu entorno Linux?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/dotfiles): Lessons from versioning Neovim, Kitty and terminal configuration while excluding secrets, sessions and machine-specific state.
- [¿El ejercicio físico ayuda a concentrarse al programar?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/el-entrenamiento-fisico-es-clave-para-programar-mejor): A cautious review of exercise, cognition and programming routines that distinguishes evidence from personal experience.
- [¿Por qué documentar software en español y dar visibilidad al talento local?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/el-talento-no-necesita-traduccion): An argument for bilingual documentation and Chilean technology communities, including the Made in Chile project.
- [¿Cómo conecté Telegram con Obsidian mediante IA? El caso de Hugr](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/hugr): The architecture of a personal assistant that validates model output before writing notes or proposing calendar events.
- [¿Cómo generar borradores para X con IA y revisión humana?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/trending2tweet): A local Python pipeline that finds technical topics, preserves sources and creates Markdown drafts without automatic publication.
- [¿Cómo diseñé ZenReader para leer artículos sin distracciones?](https://matiasblanc.dev/blog/zenreader): An open-source browser extension concept using client-side extraction, configurable typography and local storage, with explicit privacy and compatibility limitations.

## Content policy
- Articles are based on personal engineering work, experiments and clearly attributed sources.
- Project status and limitations are stated in each case study; prototypes should not be described as production systems.
- The Spanish article about exercise is educational and does not replace medical or professional advice.
- The article about Agencia IA remains a draft and is intentionally excluded from the published blog index.
